note: Per-test classification for the dev-tooling suite audit. Per-test records are in 675skf-classification.jsonl (one JSON object per line, 3421 records). See suite-necessity-and-speed-675skf.md sections 4.1-4.1.2 for the rule and the evidence sources.

classification_rule.required: contributes >=1 coverage arc no other test contributes, OR is the only member of its identical-footprint cluster
classification_rule.consolidate: zero solo arcs AND arc set byte-identical to >=1 other test; a candidate list for a human read, NOT proof of redundancy
classification_rule.investigate: zero solo arcs but a unique footprint (strict subset of a union); neither provably needed nor provably redundant

evidence_sources.coverage_footprint: pytest --cov-context=test, per-context arc sets read from the coverage SQLite data file; import-time (empty) context excluded
evidence_sources.process_spawns: subprocess.Popen wrapper installed as a pytest plugin, counting and timing real spawns per test node, classified by argv[0]
evidence_sources.mutation: bounded AST mutation of 3 modules at 100% line+branch, each replayed against its paired test file only
